code_snippet: echo '{"decision":"ask","reason":"[ADVISORY] App Zone write outside active implementation. Verify this is intentional."}'
finding: The gate's only enforcement output is {"decision":"ask"}; Claude Code's PreToolUse contract takes allow|deny|ask only under hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision and has no top-level decision field, so the hook never asks in either mode and every App Zone write proceeds. Pre-existing shape; the PR's corpus (expected.tsv:5, implement-gate.bats:35, IG-5/IG-6) and the restated constraints.json rationale pin it as the contract.
reasoning_trace: Read :135 and :230 → fetched https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks (PreToolUse output: hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision allow/deny/ask/defer; 'There is no top-level decision field for PreToolUse') → base file has the same two lines (:172,:267) → the later framework copy in this workspace fixed exactly this ('A top-level decision accepts approve|block only, so ask never goes there').
critique: A fence that emits an unrecognised reply is fail-open while documented as FAIL-ASK.
remediation: Emit {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"…"}} at :135 and :230; make decision() in implement-gate.bats:35 and expected.tsv assert that shape.

finding: Universal rule shapes are outside the grammar: bare Bash is skipped, Bash(*) becomes the exact key =*, Bash(:*) becomes the bare key * which as a bash associative-array subscript aliases the all-elements expansion, so the insertion guard at :203 is true whenever the map is non-empty and the rule is dropped silently. A universal deny is reported as 16 found; a universal allow as 16 missing.
reasoning_trace: Extracted rule_key from head and ran it: Bash→SKIPPED, Bash(*)→=*, Bash(:*)→*; bash probe: declare -A a; k='*'; ${a[$k]+x} is 'x' once any key exists.
critique: The documented 'deny wins' contract fails for the broadest rule operators actually write.
remediation: Map bare Bash, Bash(*) and an empty wildcard body to a reserved ALL key; check deny_by[ALL] before per-key lookups and allow_by[ALL] with them; add the three shapes to CP-13.
